root_cause: Existing founder reserve used only run date and broad story kind as upsert key. Once a particular recommendation ID was rejected under the semantic family gate, a later independently observed event of a different type within the same kind could not obtain its own immutable recommendation record.
prevention: Use a stable exact source family key (event type for internal verified events; URL for externally verified facts). Same family with different event IDs remains idempotent. A different real family can receive a new recommendation ID; retain recent seven-day event family filter, all original publisher/quality/source/identity checks and no duplicate override.

evidence.original_duplicates: four 2026-10-29 canonical personal recommendation IDs rejected
